name: Enamelware
source: NGX (doclib.ngxgroup.com) | Profit before tax and the corrected taxation and loss for the year: Nigerian Enamelware Plc audited statement of profit or loss and other comprehensive income for the year ended 30 April 2026, N'000, printed page 20 (file _ngx_pdf/ENAMELWA.pdf page index 20). Loss before taxation 82,335, taxation credit 2,226, loss for the year 80,109. | CRON 20261002: every income row re-based to the audited five-year financial summary on page 47 of the Nigerian Enamelware Plc financial statements for the year ended 30 April 2026 (printed in N thousand, stored here as absolute naira). The previously stored FY2024 to FY2022 rows came from an older report and contradicted it (for example stored FY2023 income tax 24,000 against the printed 885,295, and stored FY2022 cost of sales 410,455 against the printed nil). Printed: Revenue 1,301,835 / 1,431,093 / 718,349 / 227,300 / 354,804; Cost of sales 1,222,829 / 1,376,960 / 530,645 / 243,412 / nil; Gross profit 79,006 / 54,133 / 187,704 / (16,112) / 354,804; Other operating income 68,719 / 114,056 / 9,438 / 2,706,263 / nil; Other operating expenses 230,060 / 143,255 / 2,761,898 / 118,776 / 798,654; Operating (loss) profit (82,335) / 24,934 / (2,564,756) / 2,571,375 / (443,850); Profit before taxation (82,335) / 24,934 / (2,564,756) / 2,571,348 / (443,850); Taxation 2,226 / (9,458) / (33,044) / (885,295) / 12,626; Profit for the year (80,109) / 15,476 / (2,597,800) / 1,686,053 / (431,224). Ties: Income tax stored as a positive expense and negative when it is a credit, so Profit before tax less Income tax equals Profit for the year in all five years; Revenue less Cost of sales equals Gross profit in all five years. FY2022 cost of sales is printed as a dash, stored as zero so that the subtotal ties. Net Finance Costs stays empty: this summary prints no finance cost or finance income line.
